The QR code alignment operator ensures that each flyer's embedded QR links to the correct Turner Careers portal, validated by OpenCV. The role categorization kernel extracts and structures job titles into predefined categories (journeymen, foremen, laborers), forming a discrete set of roles. Content compliance filter enforces a constraint set that excludes site-specific data, ensuring uniformity across all flyers. These primitives form a dual structure where the structural consistency of the flyer is maintained through both visual and semantic layers. Failure modes include QR misalignment, role ambiguity, and inclusion of prohibited content. The system operates under a constrained optimization framework where each primitive contributes to minimizing deviation from the canonical flyer template.
